result:
No failures — the warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to this change.

## Summary

The bug was in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`: `PostResource.toArray()` built its serialized object without an `excerpt` field, even though the `PostResourceData` interface declared one. Since `PostController` (index, show, edit, search) always serializes posts through `PostResource`, every response silently dropped the excerpt while the raw value stayed in the database — explaining why search (which queries the DB directly) still worked, but the list, show, and edit pages all rendered blank excerpts.

Fixed by adding `excerpt: post.excerpt as string` to the `toArray()` return, matching the pattern of the other fields. Also added a regression test in `tests/PostController.test.ts` that creates a post and asserts `excerpt` is present in the `posts.index`, `posts.show`, and `posts.search` responses. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren check` all pass.
